title: Dialogue: Colour and Weather Idioms (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: I hadn't heard from Michal for years, then he rang yesterday.
Y: Really? Completely out of the ______?

X: Do you go to the theatre often?
Y: Once in a ______ moon.

X: You look pale today. Is everything all right?
Y: I'm a bit under the ______.

X: They argued for an hour about who left the light on.
Y: What a ______ in a teacup.

X: Everyone was talking about Zosia's new bike.
Y: I know. I was ______ with envy.

X: He said he was late because his bus broke down.
Y: That's a ______ lie - he walks to school.
